items.heading: Judd mat Gaardebounen
details: Key ingredients: smoked pork collar, broad beans, potato
Simmer smoked pork collar slowly until very tender.
Cook broad beans separately until soft.
Slice the pork and plate with the beans and boiled potatoes.
Spoon a little of the cooking liquid over the top before serving.

items.heading: Gromperekichelcher
details: Key ingredients: grated potato, onion, egg, flour, parsley
Grate potatoes and onion, squeezing out excess moisture.
Mix with egg, flour and chopped parsley.
Fry spoonfuls of the mixture until golden and crisp.
Serve hot as a savory snack.
